product.title: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Perfume Spray 100ml
product.body_html:
Elevate your fragrance collection with Tom Ford Black Orchid, a timeless masterpiece that embodies luxury, sophistication, and sensuality. Designed to captivate, this unisex fragrance is a bold statement of individuality and elegance.

Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: An exquisite blend of black truffle, fresh citrus, ylang-ylang, and blackcurrant creates an alluring and vibrant opening.
  • Heart Notes: The rare black orchid takes center stage, enriched by warm spicy accords for a mysterious and captivating heart.
  • Base Notes: A rich, velvety base of patchouli, vanilla, amber, sandalwood, and vetiver delivers an unforgettable depth and longevity.

Why You'll Love It:

  • Unisex Appeal: Suitable for anyone who appreciates rich, distinctive scents.
  • Sophisticated Design: Housed in an iconic black flacon with luxurious gold accents, making it as stunning as the fragrance itself.
  • Versatile Elegance: Perfect for evening wear, special occasions, or whenever you want to leave a lasting impression.
  • Long-Lasting Formula: Enjoy hours of captivating scent that lingers beautifully throughout the day.
